performers.note: The display name and the embedded artist tag differ. It is not established whether ‘Musopen Symphony’ is a project credit for this orchestra or a mistaken attribution. No conductor is identified.

date.note: Commons gives 2012, while the upstream collection documents project completion and public release in 2012. Neither identifies a recording session; 2012 is not promoted to a session date.

processing.value: Commons file: 24-bit FLAC; upstream collection description: 32-bit conversion.
processing.note: Commons’ file metadata documents a 48 kHz stereo 24-bit FLAC encoded with libFLAC 1.2.1. The Internet Archive’s collection-wide description says 32 bits per sample. The records do not establish whether an intervening conversion explains the difference; no mastering or noise treatment is documented.

alternatives.value: 24-bit, 48 kHz stereo FLAC in Commons file metadata.
32-bit FLAC conversion claimed in the upstream collection description.

composition.value: Commons applies PD-old-auto-expired, with Brahms’s death year 1897.
composition.note: The tag addresses the musical composition, including its pre-1931 publication basis in the United States; it is separate from the new recording.

recording.value: Rule 1 — recording release: PD-author public-domain dedication by Musopen.
recording.note: Commons explicitly applies PD-author by Musopen to the recording, separately from the composition. This is the programme’s explicit Musopen recording-release route, not an age-based inference or a claim that a Public Domain Mark is itself a licence. The session date is not needed for this route.
